title: Marigold Corporation, TY2027 semiweekly depositor with Schedule B

status.note: Accepted by IRS ATS on the first ack poll (ack CPQ7W4HV5KLX6M6RC85PPRG7KEWKTA45EC41BDB27BGAN) with returnVersion 2027Q1v2.0 and Software ID 27998441 (MEF_SOFTWARE_ID_2027). Sent 2026-11-03 for the quarter ending 2027-03-31, so ATS did not enforce R0000-191.

summary: A Q1 2027 Form 941 for a semiweekly schedule depositor, so it carries a Schedule B with daily tax liabilities. It has 10 employees and $33,594 in wages. Deposits exceed the tax, and the employer asks for the overpayment as a refund.
tests: Line 16 semiweekly depositor checkbox, which requires a Schedule B attachment
Schedule B daily liabilities across all three months (days 11 and 20, 1 and 18, 10 and 19)
Schedule B monthly and quarterly totals reconcile to 941 line 12 (8,715.89)
Social security (12.4%) and Medicare (2.9%) flowing into lines 5e, 6, 10 and 12
Overpayment of $284.11 on line 15a with 'Send a refund' checked on line 15b
Two-document ReturnData (IRS941 + IRS941ScheduleB) linked by documentId

keyFigures.label: Total social security and Medicare taxes

notes: The IRS fixed the city spelling and ZIP in the 2027 PDF. Page 1 of the Form 941 now reads 'Philadelphia, PA 19102'; the 2026 scenario printed 'Philadelephia' and ZIP 19040.
Lines 5b, 5d, 7-9 and 11 are blank on the form and absent from the XML.
The Schedule B quarter checkbox (Quarter 1) matches the 941 quarter.
